name: Banshee
gmNotes: A Banshee is a medical researcher/scanner role — not a biological species. A typical Banshee is Fey and also carries the Medical Researcher (profession) archetype. The folk stories describe a wailing omen; the underlying function is research and scanning. Do not reveal the scanner function in player-facing description unless the fiction earns it.
description: A voice on the wind that some say foretells death — a wail heard in the hills before the news arrives. In the village, hearing a banshee is an omen, and no two people agree on what it means.
